e.v: Short-month rain fill climate. Real sky only skips the fill; Arid / Normal / Wet shape how wet soil feels when the calendar undersamples rain.
Chooses the climate short months fill toward when the real sky is dry. Does not change the visual weather. Admin-only world setting in multiplayer.
Wet: wetter short-month fill. More leaching and disease pressure on rainy fills.
Normal: balanced seasonal rains for short months. Default living climate.
Arid: drier short-month fill. Nutrients hold longer; crops thirst sooner.
Real sky only: soil follows the forecast with no fill. Short months can feel sparse.
World setting - admin only in multiplayer; changes soil for everyone.
[EN] Climate moisture level - controls how quickly fungal diseases build up and how long fungicide protection lasts

[EN] Soil & Fertilizer has been turned off for this savegame because Precision Farming is active. The two mods both manage soil nutrients and cannot run at the same time. You do not need to delete this mod. To use Soil & Fertilizer instead, just disable Precision Farming for this savegame in the mod selection screen.

Soil & Fertilizer uses appended function hooks, so it runs alongside Courseplay, AutoDrive and most equipment mods without conflict. When Precision Farming is active in a savegame it detects it and stands down automatically, so the two never fight over the same fields.

In multiplayer only server admins can change settings. Change them from the panel or console on the host and every change is validated and pushed to all clients. On Realistic and Hardcore the tuning editors and challenge toggles are locked, so no one can soften the simulation mid-game.
